summary: Generates the site's copy of the graph viewer by importing the BUILT dist/ modules (loadCachedIndex, loadCoChange, buildGraphPayload, renderGraphHtml, GRAPH_TEMPLATE), so `npm run build` must run first or it fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Two constraints learned by getting them wrong: it passes an empty notes array, because the notebook is this repo's private working memory and note titles are not marketing copy; and it substitutes the home link into GRAPH_TEMPLATE BEFORE calling renderGraphHtml, since renderGraphHtml clears that slot for the standalone CLI page which has nowhere to link back to. Output is site-astro/src/graph-page.html, not public/, so an Astro route can serve /graph/ in dev.

summary: Generates the site's copy of the graph viewer by importing the BUILT dist/ modules (loadCachedIndex, loadCoChange, buildGraphPayload, renderGraphHtml, GRAPH_TEMPLATE), so `npm run build` must run first or it fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. It always passes an empty notes array to buildGraphPayload — this is a permanent design choice (graph = code structure, notebook = a separate viewer; mixing them blurs what each page answers) that holds independent of the notebook's privacy status, NOT because the notebook used to be private (that rationale, in the old comment here, went stale once the notebook was committed to git this session). It also substitutes the home link into GRAPH_TEMPLATE BEFORE calling renderGraphHtml, since renderGraphHtml clears that slot for the standalone CLI page. Output is site-astro/src/graph-page.html, not public/, so an Astro route can serve /graph/ in dev.
